Author: Moegi
Name: Chat Sharp
Description:
Chat Sharp (C#) is the game's own chat window, with unlimited tabs.
Open it with /chatsharp. /chat2vanilla still works.
Issues: https://github.com/Requine-Moegi/ChatSharp/issues

Based on Chat 2 by Anna (ascclemens) and Infi (Infiziert90), licensed under the EUPL-1.2.
Punchline: The game's chat window, with unlimited tabs.
Changelog:
**1.45.0**
- Internal name is now ChatSharp. Settings and message history copy over from ChatTwoVanilla on first load
- IPC is available as ChatSharp.*. The old ChatTwoVanilla.* channels still work

**1.44.2**
- New plugin icon: a white chat bubble with a # mark

**1.44.1**
- About lists Moegi as the author
- Issues open on this repository
- Ko-fi links for the original authors sit under the credit

**1.44.0**
- Now called Chat Sharp (C#). Open it with /chatsharp. /chat2vanilla still works.
- The window always uses the game's chat look.
- Pop-outs can be locked in place and locked in size.
- Settings are grouped into General, Appearance, Tabs, Pop-outs, Chat, and Advanced.

**1.43.21**
- Switching back to a tab stays at the bottom

**1.43.20**
- Logs and pop-outs open at the bottom

**1.43.19**
- Pop-out logs stay still at Dalamud scale 1.5
- "You obtain" lines fall back to the vanilla yellow
- Clone button on each tab in settings

**1.43.18**
- Pop-out logs stay put when new lines arrive
- "You obtain" lines use the game's loot color

**1.43.17**
- Tab and channel labels follow the Font size setting

**1.43.16**
- Wrapped chat lines no longer gain extra space when Dalamud's scale is above 1

**1.43.15**
- Option to tint the input box only while typing

**1.43.14**
- Pop-outs remember their position and size

**1.43.13**
- Font size setting; text no longer scales with Dalamud

**1.43.12**
- Chat text size now matches the game when Dalamud's scale differs

**1.43.11**
- Import your tabs from the game's chat settings
- Optional input box tint by chat channel
- Per-tab log background color and log transparency setting
- Toggle for the gold highlight on tabs with new messages
- Vanilla Style settings now have their own tab, with shorter descriptions
- Fixed pop-out resizing, saving, and text spilling past the log
- More reliable game font on all machines

**1.42.0**
- First release

Author: Moegi
Name: Tome Tracker
Description: Automatically loads and tracks all available tomes from FFXIV game data. Shows unlocked/locked status for each crafting and gathering class using direct game state access. Use /tometracker to open the main window.
Punchline: Track your crafting and gathering tome progress in real-time.
Changelog:
1.1.0
- Updated to Dalamud API 15 (.NET 10)
- Fixed ItemAction API changes for Lumina compatibility
- Author changed to Moegi
